subject: Chemistry
questionText: For the gaseous dissociation reaction $\text{N}_2\text{O}_4(g) \rightleftharpoons 2\text{NO}_2(g)$, the standard Gibbs free energy change at $T = 300\text{ K}$ is $\Delta G^\circ = 5.75\text{ kJ/mol}$. Take $R = 8.314\text{ J/(mol K)}$ and $\ln(10) = 2.3$. Calculate the equilibrium constant $K_p$ (rounded to 1 decimal place).
